known_facts.String: Released official text states that the first cycle has greater total action value than later cycles, without a numeric constant.

rationale.String: The standard challenge clock requires exact integer windows; 150/100 preserves the only released ordering and matches the shared cycle convention.

List.String: omit the stage clock|use equal cycle windows

replacement_condition.String: Replace with a released configuration constant or reproducible action-value trace.

selected_behavior.String: Use 150 action value for the first cycle and 100 for later cycles, while preserving one stage-local clock across waves.

known_facts.String: Released official text proves that uncleared Knights protect the King and that Plight starts with active protection; no complete numeric effect program is public.

rationale.String: The lifecycle and availability remain executable while combat parity stays explicitly bounded.

List.String: invent three stacking buffs|treat protection as absent

replacement_condition.String: Replace when released ability programs identify the protection contributions and parameters.

selected_behavior.String: Track one active protection contribution per uncleared Knight and expose the count to battle assembly without applying invented combat numbers.

known_facts.String: Successful Knight clears record participants and account equipment instances; retries may use current progression and have explicit replacement/reset behavior.

rationale.String: The current shared participant seam intentionally owns immutable resolved builds and does not expose account inventory identities.

List.String: treat opaque build digests as equipment instance IDs|mutate a sealed participant lock

replacement_condition.String: Replace when activity preparation accepts a typed account-equipment snapshot and deterministic lock replacement command.

selected_behavior.String: One runtime instance locks three disjoint Knight teams and one independent King team. A changed build starts a new instance; no account equipment identity is inferred from BuildDigest.
